rules.condition: Service contract whose estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: Consider how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire
rules.verbatim_quote: consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire

rules.condition: Any contract
rules.required_action: Contract must be in accordance with a decision of the Council, the Executive, or within the Scheme of Delegation
rules.approver: Council; Executive; or under the Scheme of Delegation an Executive Decision Maker, a Council Committee or Sub-Committee, or an officer or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision:

rules.condition: Any contract
rules.required_action: Contract must be in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the approved Budget
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: Contract award with a value over £500,000
rules.required_action: Award is a Key Decision of the Council
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: Service Director has no delegated authority to enter into the contract
rules.required_action: Obtain approval in accordance with Appendix A before award
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Service Director does not have delegated authority to enter into a contract, approval in accordance with Appendix A is required before the contract can be awarded.

rules.condition: All expenditure exceeding £500
rules.required_action: Publish expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors
rules.verbatim_quote: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: Invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000
rules.required_action: Publish details of every such invitation to tender
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: Contracts in progress and awarded
rules.required_action: Publish a register of contracts with key information such as contract value, duration and supplier
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: Service areas
rules.required_action: Report contract information to the relevant board monthly in the format required by Procurement Legislation
rules.approver: Service areas (reporting to the relevant board)
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: Any contract award
rules.required_action: Ensure contractors meet minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers undertaking procurement are responsible for ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council’s minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.

rules.condition: Contract opportunities advertised by the relevant Service Director
rules.required_action: Advertise electronically on the Council’s Procurement Portal so they also appear on the Central Digital Platform (CDP)
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities being advertised by the relevant Service Director should be done so electronically on the Council’s Procurement Portal

rules.condition: Contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold
rules.required_action: Advertise on the CDP database before any other advertising medium
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database

rules.condition: CDP notices
rules.required_action: CDP notices approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate

rules.condition: Estimating Total Contract Value
rules.required_action: Total Contract Value is a genuine estimate over the full potential duration, including extensions, options and VAT
rules.verbatim_quote: Total Contract Value is a genuine estimate of the total value over the full potential duration of the contract, not just the initial term.

rules.condition: Any contract
rules.required_action: No artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: Repeat purchases and/or purchases of a similar type in a specified period
rules.required_action: Seek advice on the application of the Procurement Legislation where such repeat purchases are envisaged
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers responsible for such procurement should therefore seek advice on the application of the Procurement Legislation where they envisage that they may be required to make such purchases.

rules.condition: Contract with an estimated value more than the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: Issue an electronic Invitation to Tender; tenders submitted electronically via the Procurement Portal
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: Electronic tenders
rules.required_action: Portal and ITT specify the submission format; tenders held in a secure account locked until the opening date and time
rules.verbatim_quote: such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: Tender received after the specified opening time and date
rules.required_action: Do not accept or consider a late tender unless exceptional circumstances exist and the other tenders have not been opened
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: Opening of tenders on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: Opening conducted by a Procurement Officer, with an audit record maintained on the e-tendering system
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: Quotes and tenders
rules.required_action: Evaluate against criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: Contract award
rules.required_action: Award on the most advantageous quote or tender representing best value for money, not only lowest price, save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council

rules.condition: Contract with a value of more than £24,999.99: competitive purchasing process may be excepted or waived in the circumstances in 7.2.1 and 7.2.2
rules.required_action: Competition may be excepted or waived only in the listed circumstances, subject to 7.4
rules.verbatim_quote: contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

rules.condition: Contract not subject to the relevant Procurement Legislation Rules; urgent work, supply or service
rules.required_action: Exception available where work is required as a matter of urgency and delay would likely cause financial loss, personal injury or damage to property
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts which are not subject to the relevant Procurement Legislation Rules, the work, supply or service is required as a matter of urgency and a delay would be likely to lead to financial loss, personal injury or damage to property; or

rules.condition: Discretionary exception
rules.required_action: Executive Director and/or Chief Executive may proceed in the most expedient manner, acting lawfully, with reasons recorded in writing
rules.approver: Relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: Any waiver of or exception to these Rules
rules.required_action: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or exception; an officer seeking a waiver must do so in advance and only in exceptional circumstances
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: Exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer must approve the exception
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: Exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer consults the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director; exception report approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: S.151 Officer (consulting the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director)
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board

rules.condition: Exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend to the Executive; exception report prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.approver: Executive (on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: Any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: Fully document the exception or waiver
rules.verbatim_quote: be fully documented;

rules.condition: Contract where the competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Written exception report, with reasons, submitted in advance to the relevant board
rules.approver: Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (submits to the relevant board)
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board

rules.condition: Any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer approves and records that the reasons were considered and the circumstances are genuinely exceptional
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver

rules.condition: Use of a Purchasing Scheme
rules.required_action: Seek advice confirming the Council may use the scheme, the purchases fall within its coverage, and it complies with the Procurement Legislation
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: Contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Produce a written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation

rules.condition: Report under 9.1
rules.required_action: Keep the report for three years; it may be requested by the Cabinet Office
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: All procurement procedures regardless of value
rules.required_action: Document progress of every procurement and keep the documentation for three years from the award
rules.verbatim_quote: Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: All purchases
rules.required_action: Keep written evidence (including electronic evidence) of all purchases
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: Contracts as detailed in Appendix B
rules.required_action: Contract in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: Sealed contract documents
rules.required_action: Legal Services retains all sealed contract documents
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: Award of any contract
rules.required_action: Notify the award so it is recorded on the Council Contract Register
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: Every contract
rules.required_action: Include the standard clauses of the relevant Standard Form of Agreement
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement

rules.condition: Standard Form of Agreement to be amended
rules.required_action: Service Director prepares or amends the form of contract for approval
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: Contracts, where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include the minimum clauses listed in 10.7.1-10.7.10 (scope, time, quality, insurance, failure, legislation, data, termination for improper conduct, payment, specifications)
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: Payment obligations in contracts
rules.required_action: Contract requires payment no later than 30 days from the date the invoice is valid and undisputed
rules.verbatim_quote: any payment due from the Council is made no later than 30 days from the date on which the relevant invoice is regarded as valid and undisputed; and

rules.condition: Relaxation of full indemnities
rules.required_action: Relaxation only if authorised in writing
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: Contract estimated to exceed £500,000 for works (or supplies or services by a particular date or series of dates)
rules.required_action: Service Director should consider requiring a performance bond of at least 10% of the contract value
rules.verbatim_quote: the relevant Service Director should consider requiring a performance bond (for an amount equal to at least 10% of the value of the contract) from the contractor

rules.condition: Performance bond required
rules.required_action: Bond in a form approved by Legal Services and included in the Invitation to Tender
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: Performance bond not considered necessary
rules.required_action: Written risk assessment, approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property, and a copy kept on the contract file
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must:

rules.condition: Every contract
rules.required_action: Assess every contract for risk; where insurance is needed set cover levels and check the contractor holds current policies
rules.approver: Service Director (in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property)
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract should be assessed for risk.

rules.condition: Affixing the Seal
rules.required_action: Sealing attested and witnessed in writing
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them

rules.condition: Every sealing of a document
rules.required_action: Consecutively numbered entry in a book or electronic record signed by the person attesting
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record

rules.condition: Contract whose value is above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Contract is sealed
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: Documents executed on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal
rules.required_action: Register of such documents kept
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: Delegated authority to award
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or officers nominated by the Service Director in writing)
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Delegated authority to award, provided a written report is provided and approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); relevant board approves the report
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Key Decision delegated to the Service Director, provided (a) a written report is approved by the relevant board and (b) the decision follows the Call-In and Forward Plan Parts
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided:

rules.condition: Total Contract Value of £2.5million or more
rules.required_action: Executive approval; the Executive receives quarterly reports on contracts being procured
rules.verbatim_quote: Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below.

rules.condition: Total value (exclusive of VAT) above £1,000 and less than £25,000; no advertising mandated
rules.required_action: Seek at least one quote from an appropriate source
rules.verbatim_quote: At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: Goods and services, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier (where appropriate and possible)
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: Goods and services, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: Works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier (where appropriate and possible)
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: Works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: Works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Full competitive tender; at least five written tenders sought via the Procurement Portal
rules.verbatim_quote: Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: Works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Place an advert on the Portal together with information on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

rules.condition: Goods and services, works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Procurement Legislation procedures: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal
rules.verbatim_quote: Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal.

rules.condition: Goods and services, works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Place an advert on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: An advert should be placed on the CDP

rules.condition: Contract excluded under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: Key decisions recorded and the relevant PSR process followed
rules.verbatim_quote: Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: Contract awarded under a Purchasing Scheme where no further competition is undertaken
rules.required_action: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Extension to an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such extension
rules.required_action: Approval of the S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: Variation of scope of an existing contract (provided for in the contract or permitted by the Procurement Legislation), value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: Variation of scope of an existing contract (provided for in the contract or permitted by the Procurement Legislation), value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Approval of the relevant board following an extension report with recommendation from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: Contract for the listed social care services (residential, supported living, SEN school placements, personalised packages, specific-provider needs, Shared Lives)
rules.required_action: Record the reasons for the choice of provider on the individual’s case notes
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual’s case notes.

rules.condition: Exemption applied; contract with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Contract approved by the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.
